# External reference repositories

The repositories in this directory are read-only implementation references for
StoryMotion feasibility and compatibility analysis. They are not imported by the
application and their source code must not be copied into StoryMotion without an
explicit license and attribution review.

- `novelwriter/`: story-generation architecture reference only.
- `penshot/`: SDK, API, output-schema, and compatibility reference.

Snapshot date: 2026-07-15. The archives were fetched from GitHub's official
codeload endpoint after Git transport timed out, so these directories do not
contain upstream Git history or a pinned commit SHA.

- `novelwriter/` has no repository license; study its design only.
- `penshot/` is MIT licensed; preserve its included copyright and license notice.

See `docs/research/2026-07-15-open-source-reference-review.md` for the review.
